messages.subject: Onboarding flow, first pass (wireframes)
messages.body_text:
Hi Aditya,

First pass of the onboarding flow is in Figma: https://figma.example/orbit/onboarding-v1

Five screens, as agreed at kickoff: Welcome, phone verification, PIN setup, permissions, and a five-card tour. These are wireframes, not final visuals. I'm still on track for the finished onboarding screens by the 19th.

Two things I'd like a call on:
1. The tour is five cards. Is that too many for field agents?
2. PIN setup is a 4-digit PIN. Meridian's summary deck didn't specify a length.

Rahul, cc'ing you so you see the screen inventory early.

Sana

messages.subject: Re: Onboarding flow, first pass (wireframes)
messages.body_text:
Sana,

Approved, with one change: cut the tour from five cards to three. The agents will swipe past five; three they might read. Everything else stands.

4-digit PIN is fine. Meridian confirmed a 4-digit PIN on the summary call, keep it.

Aditya

On Wed, 9 Sep 2026 at 11:12, Sana <sana@orbit.example> wrote:
> First pass of the onboarding flow is in Figma ...
> 1. The tour is five cards. Is that too many for field agents?

messages.subject: Re: Onboarding flow, first pass (wireframes)
messages.body_text:
Three cards is also less work for me, so no complaints.

One question: does the permissions screen ask for location? Offline sync doesn't need it, and Meridian's agents will say no anyway.

Rahul

messages.subject: Re: Onboarding flow, first pass (wireframes)
messages.body_text:
No location. The permissions screen asks for camera and notifications only. Camera for the inspection photos, notifications for sync status.

Updating the tour to three cards now. Final screens still by the 19th.

Sana

messages.subject: Re: Onboarding flow, first pass (wireframes)
messages.body_text:
Good. Closing this thread, see you Monday.

Aditya
